info.title: TimDS Host API
info.description: Portable hosted editing and multiplayer contract. The toolkit selects a host URL and speaks v1; it does not depend on Supabase, the portal, git or a specific runtime. The portal implements this contract today; a standalone host can implement the same routes. Optional X-TimDS-API-Version and JSON apiVersion default to 1. Success JSON carries apiVersion:1. Unknown response fields must be ignored. Credentials come from the existing identity/device flow; this document covers host work operations, not identity provisioning or operator catalogue administration. Internal Worker RPC, callbacks and consumer MCP JSON-RPC are separate service boundaries. Sessions, submissions, claims, members and events are stored behind one collaboration store. Publication is preflight, merge, build, prepare, release, close with serializable step receipts. New asynchronous behavior is triggered by pushes or session alarms. Every accepted coordinator command appends one audit event with a per-source monotonic seq; GET .../events?after=<seq> replays them in commit order exactly once.

host.description: Configured host origin; no toolkit vendor dependency.

x-timds-mcp.description: MCP is a separate JSON-RPC boundary over Streamable HTTP, not a v1 REST response envelope. Contribution tools reuse coordinator authority and lifecycle operations; isolated session checks add retained check receipts. Tool schemas are discovered with tools/list.
x-timds-mcp.publication: Explicit publisher-only tools support preflight, isolated dry-run, publication with durable polling, and rollback with stable operationId plus expectedCurrentVersionId. Session updates, checks and submissions do not publish.

get.summary: Replay the source's append-only event feed after a sequence cursor
get.description: Ascending by seq, the per-source monotonic sequence committed with each event row. Reads committed rows without waiting on the source's writer queue; the caller needs the same read authorization as active-work. Resume with after set to the last seq received; latestSeq is the newest committed seq and hasMore reports a further page. Each event is delivered once per cursor walk, with no gaps across coordinator restarts. publication_stage details.stage is one of preflight, merge, build, prepare, release, flip, close (the Workflow stage names); the published event commits during flip, before the close stage row.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Source UUID or URL-encoded immutable system ID (encode the slash in organization/system).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return events with seq greater than this cursor. Defaults to 0 (the beginning). A non-negative integer; anything else fails with 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum events per page. Defaults to 100; values above 500 are capped at 500. Zero, negative or non-integer values fail with 400.

parameters.name: X-TimDS-API-Version
parameters.description: Omission means v1. Unsupported values fail with 400.

200.description: Successful operation. Events are ordered by ascending seq.

post.summary: Issue a single-use ticket for the source's live event feed
post.description: Requires the same read authorization as active-work (and the OAuth write scope that every POST requires). The ticket is an opaque 256-bit base64url token bound to the calling principal and this source, valid for 60 seconds and consumed by the first WebSocket upgrade that presents it. Browsers cannot send a bearer header on a WebSocket upgrade, so the upgrade route accepts this ticket instead. Issue a fresh ticket for every connection and reconnection.

parameters.name: source

200.description: Ticket issued.

get.summary: Open the source's live event and presence feed (WebSocket)
get.description: Not a JSON operation. Send GET with Upgrade: websocket; the request carries no bearer header and is authorized only by the single-use ticket from createFeedTicket, which must belong to this source. A same-host Origin header is required when present. On success the host answers 101 Switching Protocols, replays committed events with seq greater than after in ascending seq order, then streams new events as they commit; a connection never sends a seq at or below one it already sent. Server text messages are JSON: {type:'event', seq, event} where event is the same view the events route returns (Event with seq, principal_name and actor_name); {type:'ready', after, latestSeq} once replay completes; {type:'presence', viewers:[{principalId, name, type, viewing:{sessionId}|{draftId}|null}]} on every connect, disconnect and viewing change; {type:'error', message} for an invalid client message. Client text messages: the raw string ping (answered pong without waking the coordinator; send every 25 seconds), {type:'ping'} (no-op), {type:'presence'} (returns the current viewer list), {type:'viewing', sessionId} | {type:'viewing', draftId} | {type:'viewing', viewing:null}. Close codes: 4410 the source is archived, deleting or deleted (do not reconnect); 4401 access changed (reconnect with a new ticket); 4100 the bounded replay (5,000 events per connection) has more rows (reconnect at once with after set to the last seq received); 1011 replay or delivery failed (reconnect with backoff). Presence is ephemeral and never persisted.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Source UUID or URL-encoded immutable system ID (encode the slash in organization/system).

parameters.name: ticket
parameters.description: Single-use feed ticket from createFeedTicket.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Replay events with seq greater than this cursor; use the last seq received when reconnecting. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: Upgrade
parameters.description: Must be websocket; anything else fails with 426.

101.description: Switching Protocols. The connection carries the JSON text messages described above.

post.summary: Restore a previously published immutable version
post.description: Requires a source publisher grant at request and pointer transaction. Rejects active or interrupted publication with staged bytes. Does not change source files or any consumer pin. Optional operationId makes an identical rollback safely retryable; optional expectedCurrentVersionId compares the current pointer atomically before changing it. Dry runs return currentVersionId for that guard. A committed operation replay returns its original receipt without changing a newer pointer.

identity.description: Identity-bound TimDS CLI credential or authenticated application session. Consumer-only and legacy unbound tokens cannot author. Publication requires a separate source grant.

error.description: Human-readable error. Credentials are never included.

path.description: Safe repository-relative path; no absolute paths, parent traversal or .git.

key.description: Logical dotted key or JSON pointer identifying the conflicting key; absent for whole-file conflicts.

base.description: Original value or file descriptor; null when absent.

mine.description: Submitted value or file descriptor; null when deleted.

theirs.description: Current target value or file descriptor; null when deleted.

note.description: Human instruction, required and nonempty for agent principals.

items.description: path#dotted.key=mine|theirs or path#/JSON/pointer=mine|theirs. A path alone chooses the local whole file. Requires mainRevision.

lastUpdateHash.description: Optional compare-and-swap hash from session.lastUpdateHash. Omit for older clients relying on baseRevision alone.

ChangeSet.description: At most 4,000 combined changed/deleted paths and 10 MiB decoded changed file content. Both baseRevision and optional lastUpdateHash protect shared writers.

baseRevision.description: Full revision; empty only while starting.

liveUrl.description: Live preview URL, empty when unavailable.

runner.description: Present on active-work sessions/drafts and the session status view.

queueLength.description: Requests queued for this session and not yet started (active-work and status views).

Event.description: Append-only audit. Additional fields are forward compatible. Every accepted coordinator command writes one row: session_started, draft_created, member_joined, claimed, updated, submitted, closed, request_received, request_started, request_submitted, request_failed, publication_queued, publication_stage (details_json.stage), publication_failed, published, live_state (details_json.state), plus authority_changed, source_deletion_fenced, source_deleted and deleted_source_imported. Unknown event types must be ignored. Request events carry originating_request_id and details_json.requestId; submitted Requests also carry details_json.submissionId; failures carry a safe details_json.error.

seq.description: Per-source monotonic sequence assigned in the same transaction as the row; feed cursor.

latestSeq.description: Newest committed seq for the source; 0 when it has no events.

hasMore.description: True when more events follow the last returned seq.

status.description: Execution job state; runner state tracks the active sandbox.

queuePosition.description: 0 when the Request is running, finished, starts its own session, or is next with no runner ahead of it; otherwise the number of Requests ahead of it in its target session, counting the one whose runner currently holds the session.

targetSessionId.description: The session or draft named when the Request was created; null for a Request that starts its own session.

preflight.description: Authorization, merge and validation receipt; dryRun never moves source or published pointers.

currentVersionId.description: Current pointer captured by a successful rollback preflight.

previousVersionId.description: Pointer replaced by this committed rollback, retained unchanged on replay.

canRollback.description: Current principal has the active publisher grant. Storage eligibility alone is not permission.

canAdmin.description: Current D1 principal is an active host administrator; portal roles confer no host authority.

legacyPublicRoots.description: Explicit reviewed portal-public-roots-v1 hostname metadata; no public pointer or content.

ticket.description: Opaque single-use credential for one WebSocket upgrade.

url.description: wss:// (ws:// on a local http host) upgrade URL for openSourceFeed carrying the ticket; append after=<seq> to resume.

RunnerPresence.description: The designer runner's stored state for one session, read from its live session record without starting a container. idle: no Request has run in the session; sleeping: the last run finished and its container stopped; unknown: the record could not be read within the bounded timeout.

HostError.description: Error response. 400 invalid input/version; 401 authentication required; 403 grant required; 404 unavailable; 409 changed/busy/lifecycle conflict; 410 expired; 413 size limit; 429 capacity; 503 provider unavailable. Retry uncertain outcomes with the same idempotency identity.
